text_block_list.text:
One day in the lead up to the Arima
Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I have planned a holiday party.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In Japan, the holidays are spent among
family
and friends, or with that special
someone.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Under ordinary circumstances, I would
spend the holidays with you, Trainer,
but the Arima Kinen is
scheduled to take
place during that time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I have planned a party based
on
existing data and materials that will
emulate the
"holiday spirit."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Preparations are complete, and we can
start at
any time. Shall I begin the
festivities?

Without wasting a second, Mihono
Bourbon kicks
off the party.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
First, I will sing a festive song as an
icebreaker.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I rehearsed in my room last night. Please
enjoy
"Jingle Bells."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Jingle bells, jingle bells.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Jingle all the way. Oh, what fun it is to
ride...

Mihono Bourbon's monotone singing
continues
for some time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Has the ice been broken, Trainer?

The ice is thicker than a glacier now, but
I can't
bring myself to say that when I
see the expectant
look in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Mission complete. Now, we will move on
to small
talk and meal time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I conducted a campus-wide survey
beforehand to
ensure that you would be
satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I created a menu with the top ten
"quintessential
festive dishes."

She starts bringing out her dishes one by
one, and
soon the table is filled with an
array of colorful
foods.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have prepared roast chicken, roast
beef, stew,
mince pies, lasagna...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Wreath salad, canapés, creamy pasta,
and a
chocolate log for dessert.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have also prepared a menu of foods to
be
delivered as a contingency plan.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Now, you may "dig in," as they say.

This is way too much, but Mihono
Bourbon went
through so much trouble,
so I want to polish off
my plate.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I see that you have consumed
everything. I hope
it was to your liking.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, you have not moved an inch
since
finishing. Is something the matter?

Although the food was delicious, I'm so
stuffed
that I can hardly breathe, never
mind move
around.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Then my mission is complete. Moving
onto the
next phase—presents.

Mihono Bourbon takes out a box that
appears to
be a present.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It was unclear to me what you would
want, so I
decided to prepare a very
practical gift.

I open the box to find... a laundry
detergent set!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I came up with the idea while
researching how new neighbors greet
each other. I was split between this and
soba noodles... What do you
think?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Mission complete. Present allocation
successful.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Incidentally, I use this brand of
detergent and am
confident in its
cleansing efficacy.

For a while after, all of my clothes smell
like
Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I will be satisfied if you like it.

I open the box to find... a hand-knit
scarf!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I created this scarf using merino wool
delivered
straight from New Zealand.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It has excellent heat retention,
feels soft
on the
skin, and also boasts great odor
resistance.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to make something that would
help keep
you warm during these harsh
winter days.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That is excellent to hear.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Mission complete. Present allocation
successful.

There's not a single frayed thread. It
looks just
like a scarf you would find at a
store.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I excel at simple,
repetitive
work.
choice_data_list: You're really good at this, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My movements were so precise when I
was
creating it that Nishino Flower
recorded a video.

I wrap the scarf around my neck while
resisting
the urge to ask to see the
video.
